verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API, so international employment through an employer of record or owned-entity global payroll is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions employing workers in other countries, an employer-of-record service, or multi-country payroll. The docs cover payroll, employee and contractor management, taxes and benefits with no international scope (the W-4 example points to a domestic focus). Contractor payments are a different capability and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll
